skill.description: ** Free, open-source (MIT), local-first Swiss accounting MCP server. An AI agent posts double-entry journal entries, categorises and chases invoices, and prepares the MWST-Abrechnung (the Swiss VAT return), with a minimalist Studio for human oversight. Posted entries are append-only and immutable, corrections are reversing entries, and every query is tenant-scoped. The books stay in a local SQLite file on your own machine, and it opens no outbound socket.
